findings.title: Inventory still keys stock by the raw SKU string
findings.why: The README says `ab-102`, ` AB-102 ` and `AB-102` are the same product. The new openspec product-catalog spec says SKUs are case-insensitive 'wherever a product is looked up'. Only `Catalog.find` was fixed. `restock`, `available`, `adjust`, `lowStock` and `movements` use the string as given. `inventory.restock('lb-220', 5)` therefore adds stock under a different key from the one orders reserve (`LB-220`), and the order then fails as out of stock. The new tests pass only because they restock with the canonical SKU.

findings.title: Order stores the coupon code as typed rather than canonical
findings.why: `coupon: request.coupon` keeps ` welcome ` as entered, while SKUs are shown canonical. `giveBack` canonicalises, so behaviour is correct. The order record and receipt can still show a non-canonical code.

findings.title: Tests do not cover the day before a coupon starts or the half-cent coupon rounding
findings.why: The archived task 2.2 and the coupon-discounts spec list a refusal the day before the first day and a 1005-cent × 10% → 101 rounding scenario. The new test covers only the first and last day. The existing test covers only the day after expiry.
